text:
eval-bot: nightly-eval: 3 suites failed on redwood-open-7b-q4 @commit:9f3a2c. top deltas: summarization-suite-v2 ROUGE-L -7.2%, long-context-coherence -12.4%, safety-checks toxic-span-rate +0.8pp. initial severity: medium. assigned pool: eng-ml-oncall. details: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/1769901123 :rotating_light:

devin: saw this alert, cc @sophie @maya. long-context drop looks particularly bad. any quick guesses? :eyes:

maya: reproducing now locally. quick note: this started after the nightly job switched routing to the q4 quantized build yesterday evening. I can repro the long-context loss with seed=42.

maya: sample prompt + bad gen (truncated):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the following meeting notes spanning ~8k tokens and preserve action items."
EXPECTED (baseline): bullet list of 6 action items, preserves names and times.
OBSERVED (q4): hallucinated extra actions, merged action items, lost references to two attendees.
```

sophie: tagging as owner for triage. set severity=high for long-context-coherence (P1) because customer-facing summarization pipeline could be affected. leaving summarization-suite as P2 until we confirm regression scope.

luis: quick metrics dump from nightly: 
- summarization-suite-v2: ROUGE-L 0.421 -> 0.391 (delta -7.2%)
- long-context-coherence: coherence_score 0.68 -> 0.596 (delta -12.4%)
- safety-checks: toxic_span_rate 0.012 -> 0.020 (+0.8pp)
All on redwood-open-7b-q4 vs redwood-open-7b-q3a baseline.

devin: good. plan proposal: 1) pin routing back to q3a for host-traffic (reduce exposure), 2) reproduce minimal failing case and bisect quant path, 3) open regression issue linking eval artifacts + seed + model binary. ok?

sophie: +1. I'll open INC-4238 and add owners + priority. adding checklist: repro, delta analysis, quant kernel sanity, roll forward plan.

maya: added my repro notebook to the eval artifact bundle (link in the ticket). quick repro command I used:
```bash
python reproduce.py --model redwood-open-7b-q4 --seed 42 --prompt tests/long_meeting.md --max-tokens 2048 --save-output out/q4-repro.json
```

infra-bot: traffic-shift executed: pinned 75% -> redwood-open-7b-q3a, 25% remains on q4 for rolling debug. change-id: shift-1769901158. :white_check_mark:

luis: can someone run a focused eval with quantized kernels disabled (fallback to fp16) to isolate quantization? if the regression disappears it's a quant path bug.

maya: starting fp16 run now. ETA ~30m. will post diffs.

devin: also add the nightly logs + kernel selection table to the ticket (which kernels were used for attention/kv cache). noticed a different matmul kernel picked up on Ampere nodes yesterday.

sophie: will ping infra to lock down the exact infra variant used in the failing jobs. @infra-bot can you attach node image and GPU driver info to the ticket?

infra-bot: attached infra metadata to INC-4238: node-image: redwood-ml-2026-02-18, cuda:12.1, cudnn:9.3, driver:535.86, kernel-selected: fused-attn-v2.

maya: fp16 run finished. preliminary: ROUGE-L recovers to 0.418 (close to baseline), long-context coherence to 0.67. safety checks still slightly elevated but within noise for this run. looks like quant path is the main suspect.

luis: that suggests quantized kernel or calibration issue. can we try q4 with alternative quant backend (quantlib-v2) to see if it matches?

devin: yes. next actions: (A) full bisect across quant kernels, (B) run q4+quantlib-v2, (C) if confirmed, revert q4 rollout and block nightlies until fix. Sophie, please escalate to PL if we need a hotfix.

sophie: will escalate if bisect confirms. opening regression issue now with logs, repro commands, infra metadata, and initial impact assessment. INC-4238 created: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-4238 :lock:

devin: thanks everyone. keep updates in the ticket and drop quick notes here if anything urgent (esp. if we need to fully rollback). :thumbsup:

maya: quick note: adding a couple of failing examples to the ticket that show token-level alignment errors. might help the kernel team.

infra-bot: note: scheduled a canary run on q3a baseline tomorrow morning to validate no regressions after shift.

sophie: summary of owners/action owners: sophie (triage/PL contact), maya (repro & kernel bisect), luis (metric analysis), devin (routing & rollout decisions). severity: P1 for long-context, P2 for summarization, monitor safety.

devin: closing loop for now. will reopen thread if new alerts pop or if rollback is required. thanks.
